key_insight: M$^3$-Gen generates plausible gene expression profiles from histopathology images plus clinical metadata, while also highlighting which image regions influenced the output.
clinical_relevance: This could help researchers study molecular tumor patterns when direct gene-expression testing is costly, limited, or unavailable.
method: Conditions a GAN on histopathology images and clinical variables
Uses contrastive learning to build a shared latent representation across modalities
Adds attention-based fusion for interpretable, modality-guided generation
evidence_signal: In TCGA evaluations, the model produced realistic and functionally meaningful gene expression profiles.
watch_item: Results are based on retrospective TCGA data, so external validation and clinical deployment testing are still needed.
paper_title: M$^3$-Gen: Interpretable Multimodal Generation of Gene Expression Profiles Using Clinical and Imaging Data
